name: manual_33ee40
claim: Windows peer sends stay on plain HTTP until PEER_CA_SHA256 matches one CERTIFICATE block in mac-ca-*/orama-lan-ca.pem or PEER_CA_FILE. A mismatched or missing pin strips the bearer token. MAC_IP must equal the discovered Mac address or items queued on the plain portal port are not remapped to 8443. A flush is delivered only when that drop result has ok true, received_at, and a matching byte count.

decisions.notes: The first flush used HTTP because the pin was not loaded, and a later HTTPS flush still timed out against a stale discovery record. Queued files must stay queued until an authenticated receipt exists.
